runtime.note: Unmodified upstream oven-sh/bun canary; every registration mode below is an upstream Bun API.

registrationModes.bunfig-preload: Bun.plugin from a preload entry named in bunfig.toml or --preload (docs/runtime/plugins). AOT executables ignore bunfig preload and reject --preload unless built with --aot-allow-code-from-disk (docs/compiler/compatibility.mdx).
registrationModes.bun-plugin: Bun.plugin called from program code at run time. In an AOT executable it only applies to code that is not compiled in, which needs --aot-allow-code-from-disk.
registrationModes.bun-build-plugin: BunPlugin passed to Bun.build({ plugins }); runs at build time, so the executable does not load it.
registrationModes.napi: N-API addon (.node), embedded by bun compile or loaded with process.dlopen.
registrationModes.bun-ffi: bun:ffi dlopen of a native library; works in AOT executables (cc() excepted on Linux 6.7+).
registrationModes.none: Library or data imported by code; no Bun hook.

aotFlag: true when the component works inside a `bun compile --aot` executable without --preload and without --aot-allow-code-from-disk; false for bunfig-preload and run-time Bun.plugin registration
measurement: dust -b on the workstation checkout; 0 B submodules are declared but not initialized
